title: Pitya Ukhma (black pot)
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Rav Nachman used this expression for Rav Eina in [Pesachim 88a](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.88a.15-16), Rabbi Assi used it for Rabbi Zeira in Avodah Zarah 16a as cited by Hyman, and Rava used it for Rafram bar Papa in Berakhot 53a as cited by Hyman.[^1]

notes.text: The last two passages occur in [Avodah Zarah 16b](https://www.sefaria.org/Avodah_Zarah.16b.9-11) and [Berakhot 50a](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.50a.16). In Avodah Zarah the consulted text calls the speaker Rav Assi. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3016&lang=en) cites all three and another instance of Rav Nachman addressing Rav Eina, in [Megillah 14b](https://www.sefaria.org/Megillah.14b.12-13).
